name: agents
description: AI agents driven by markdown configs or code, with auto-tool-discovery from registered plugins

optional.description: The Databricks-hosted LLM your agents will call when they don't pin their own model. Required for every agent that omits `model:` in code or `endpoint:` in markdown frontmatter — without it those agents fail to register at startup. The endpoint name is read from `DATABRICKS_SERVING_ENDPOINT_NAME` at runtime; the same env var the `serving` plugin uses, so wiring one endpoint covers both. Only **streaming-capable** endpoints are supported (Foundation Model APIs, external chat models like GPT/Claude). Omit when every agent pins its own model.

name.description: Streaming-capable serving endpoint name. Required by agents that don't pin `model:` themselves; shared with the `serving` plugin so one value covers both.
